name: Trakkr
title: trakkr.ai
shortDescription: Trakkr provides real-time monitoring and visibility for large language models (LLMs), catering to businesses that rely on AI-driven data analysis. It offers tools for tracking performance, detecting anomalies, and optimizing operations. An example use case is a tech company using Trakkr to ensure their AI systems operate efficiently and accurately, minimizing downtime and improving decision-making.
